heading: Happy plants in pre-loved pots.
intro: Healthy plants rehomed in second-hand ceramic pots. Not every pot we use is new, and that's the point. Each one is a one-off.

promises.title: Second-hand pots
promises.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Rescued from charity shops and car boots, cleaned and given a new life.

promises.title: Hospital-checked
promises.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Every plant is health-checked and pest-free before it goes to a new home.

promises.title: Comes with a care card
promises.body: So you know exactly what it likes from day one.

emptyBasket: Your basket is empty. Every plant in the shop is a one-off, so if you see one you love, grab it.
